scope: Copper CPU FGN/JFG, CUDA AOS, native lifecycle and exact prefixes; no timing or physical claim

metrics.timing_scope: process-local observations; preparation and configured warmup excluded from histograms
metrics.source_to_command_scope: source publication to adopted command reception; excludes plant simulation
metrics.source_interval_extra_periods_definition: derived sum(max(floor(source interval / comparison period) - 1, 0)) over measured intervals; budget comparison only, not scheduler deadline misses
metrics.exchange_scope: owner complete exchange including plant work

summary.arrival_policy: paced closed-loop future-deadline scheduling without catch-up

allocation.scope: entire simulator process after retained prefix; includes optics, transport, recording, diagnostics and controls; excludes final report serialization; interim controls and pause reports remain included

truth.scope: observed public simulated pupil variance at global sequences; sparse samples do not independently replay intervening commands; diagnostics excluded from capacity runs
